name: Pyielink
description: Pyielink remote access framework — screen sharing, file transfer, and terminal access
info:
Pyielink v0.5.0 remote access framework

Install via npm (downloads Rust binary automatically):
  npm install -g pyielink

Connect:
  pyielink user@192.168.1.100    # GUI mode
  pyielink --repl user@192.168.1.100  # REPL terminal mode

First run: pyielink --setup
  Downloads Rust binary from CDN and sets up configuration.

Docs:  https://github.com/EMTYPYIE/Pyielink
Support: Issues https://github.com/EMTYPYIE/Pyielink/issues
